summary: Innate Pharma S.A. furnished a Form 6-K on November 5, 2026, carrying its Exhibit 99.1 press release reporting third-quarter 2026 business and financial results. The filing discloses a cash position of €96.8 million as of September 30, 2026, with an anticipated cash runway into the end of Q1 2028. Pipeline updates include Phase 1 dose-escalation data for Nectin-4 ADC IPH4502 at ENA 2026 on November 18, lacutamab first patient dosing in Phase 3 TELLOMAK-3 expected Q1 2027 with an FDA accelerated-approval filing planned H2 2027, and an AstraZeneca-led PACIFIC-9 readout expected in H1 2027. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated; this is a routine quarterly earnings and pipeline update.
